description: Spot-to-venue lag catcher for 15-minute binary rounds: when the Binance spot price of the round's asset moves >= 0.25% inside 2s, buy the side the move implied as a post_only maker at the current ask, while that price is still <= 0.55 and within 1.5s of the trigger. Signal-only: the kernel adjudicates, sizes and gates every intent. Thesis death (issue 961 convergence, form B): declares BK_THESIS_DEATH_ENABLE = true — the stdlib default predicate (the held token's own bid reversed >= thesis_death_reversal_pct, default 25, sliding linearly to thesis_death_reversal_pct_tight, default 0 = off, as the round drains; or its quoting fields vanished/stale past thesis_death_stale_ms, default 30000) — enforced by the runtime as an unconditional same-tick full-taker close (exit_reason thesis_death_exit).
